Parent controls

This prototype runs locally and does not verify Etsy purchases. The production version will require secure server-side order verification, like Starfall.

To keep answers secret from children, use these controls away from the players.

✦ Set current progress

Testing only: select a chapter or sub-mission, then press Set progress to jump there. This updates saved progress without solving the earlier puzzles.

Clue tokens: Children can tap Use clue on the game screen to spend one of their three clues, then ask an adult for help. The button stops working at zero. Use Restore clue below if a token was spent by mistake.
